## Summary

What changed and why? Link relevant issues in this fork; mark references
to the original repository as upstream references.

## Compatibility and user impact

Describe changed diagnostics, configuration, CLI behavior or limitations.
For documentation-only changes, say so.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests where behavior changes.
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run prettier:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run bundle`
- [ ] Updated documentation and the unreleased changelog as appropriate.
- [ ] No disposable outputs, secrets or private paths included; copied
      material has recorded provenance and license terms.

Explain any checks not run and any remaining risks.
